maximum_depth_rule: All 135 canonical Phase 9 Reviewed statements are retained exactly once with their registered document, PDF location, raw text, tokens, unit, scope, operator, and unresolved comparability boundary.
version_boundary: The 2024 to 2027 basic policy, detailed strategy, overview, integrated edition, KPI material, prior strategy results, annual guide values, actuals, and resident survey remain separate versions and layers.
non_goals: Do not add the 242 registered candidate rows as if they were 242 independent canonical outcomes.
Do not merge the basic policy, detailed strategy, overview, integrated edition, and KPI material by similar wording.
Do not convert prior-strategy achievement percentages or resident sentiment into current policy achievement.
Do not calculate policy achievement, causality, or cross-prefecture ranking.
